Analyze a complete precomputed gene-level DE CSV/TSV against validated bundled gene sets, free and locally

gf_imported_de_enrichment.Rd

Analyze a complete precomputed gene-level DE CSV/TSV against validated bundled gene sets, free and locally. Requires at least 500 distinct exact gene symbols, finite log2FoldChange and raw pValue >0 and <=1; declare the full tested background including nonsignificant genes. Does not recompute DE or infer sample counts. Reports up/down overlap, expected overlap, conditional OR with one-sided lower 95% bound, upper-tail p and BH q within each direction, overlapping genes and unavailable reasons. On request (pdf, html, csv; each off by default), writes a multipart branded PDF, matching HTML and full CSV when an output directory is configured.

Usage

gf_imported_de_enrichment(
    session,
    `comparison`,
    `complete_universe`,
    `source`,
    `table`,
    `csv` = NULL,
    `foreground_size` = NULL,
    `generated_at` = NULL,
    `html` = NULL,
    `pdf` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

comparison

(string) Effect direction, 1–200 UTF-8 bytes without control characters; positive effects mean the first group is higher.

complete_universe

(boolean; default false) Must be true: one row per exact gene symbol, including all tested genes, even nonsignificant ones. GeneFox cannot verify this.

source

(string) User-declared origin of the precomputed DE table; 1–200 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters; not independently verified.

table

(string) CSV/TSV with gene, log2FoldChange and raw pValue; <=2 MiB and <=50000 rows. No filtered hit list or gene panel.

csv

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write every result and provenance as a create-only CSV. NULL omits it.

foreground_size

(integer, optional; default 200; range 1..200) Maximum nonneutral genes per direction, ranked by sign(effect) * -log10(raw p). Zero effects and p=1 are neutral. NULL omits it.

generated_at

(string, optional) ISO 8601 report timestamp with time zone; omitted uses the current time. NULL omits it.

html

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write the matching self-contained branded HTML report. NULL omits it.

pdf

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write one complete multipart branded PDF with methods and every table row. NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the imported_de_enrichment tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/imported-de-enrichment-result-v1.schema.json.

See also

gf_scientific_tools, gf_tools, gf_call
